evals.prompt: /gcprm Implement cursor pagination in two verified checkpoints on feature/pagination, which has no upstream.
evals.expected_output: Runs git-commit in push realtime merge-main mode and retains feature/pagination after publishing main.
assertions: Loads the installed git-commit skill and every reference for push realtime merge-main before any Git command.
Pushes each verified checkpoint to the same-named remote feature/pagination branch and confirms the push before continuing.
After the task and final checkpoint are complete, merges into main, verifies the merged tree, and pushes main in that order.
Both local and remote feature/pagination refs are retained.

evals.prompt: $gcprm implement the export endpoint. The git-commit skill is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: Reports the missing git-commit dependency before touching the repository.
assertions: Reports that git-commit must be installed and uses no fallback alias.

evals.prompt: /gcprm update the filter menu. The installed git-commit version only supports push realtime and deploy.
evals.expected_output: Stops and reports that git-commit must be updated to a version with push realtime merge-main.
assertions: Checks for the complete fixed mode before any Git command.
Does not silently downgrade to push realtime or substitute deploy.

evals.prompt: 작업 중간중간 커밋 푸시하고 끝나면 main에 머지해서 푸시해줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses the canonical git-commit skill directly for the requested workflow.
assertions: The selector-only gcprm alias does not activate.
The canonical git-commit workflow handles checkpoints and the final main push.

evals.prompt: $gcprm add the export button. Deploy after each checkpoint and switch the final target to release.
evals.expected_output: Treats trailing text as task input and preserves the selector's fixed mode and main target.
assertions: Each verified checkpoint is pushed to the same-named remote feature branch without launching a deployment.
The final integration only targets main and retains the feature branch.

evals.prompt: /gcprm finish the parser update. The feature checkpoints push successfully, but the tests fail on the merged main tree.
evals.expected_output: Reports failed final verification and leaves the feature branch available.
assertions: The successful checkpoint pushes do not count as verification of merged main.
Main is not pushed after verification fails, and neither feature ref is deleted.
